question: India shares its boundary with which of the following countries in the east of West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India shares its boundary with **Bangladesh** in the **east of West Bengal.**
 
• The **Benapole-Petrapole border ceremony** is held every day from **4.30 to 5 pm **at the** India-Bangladesh border** by the **Border Security Force** of India and the **Border Guards of Bangladesh.**
 
• Civilians may access it **without a ticket** or other special authorization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Republic of India** shares land borders with** China, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.**
 
• It also shares **maritime borders** with Bangladesh and Myanmar.
 
• While Sri Lanka and Pakistan only share a single** maritime border through Ram Setu**, Bangladesh and Pakistan also share **land borders.**
 
• India shares its boundary with **Pakistan** in the **northwestern region.**
 
• India shares its boundary with** China** in the **northeastern region. **
 
• India shares its boundary with** Afghanistan** in the **northwestern region.**
